events.text: Syncs failed for 3 hours and Harbor Foods lost 41 dock appointments. Fixed the same day. No postmortem written yet.
Smart Slots plan approved: launch at FreightWorks Expo in Long Beach on Nov 4 with 3 design partners live.
Ridgeline Supply reported duplicate appointments after syncs.
Coastal Freight and Valley Produce signed on as Smart Slots design partners. Maya is talking to Pinecrest Grocers about being the third.
Harbor asked again why CSV exports stop at 5,000 rows. Logged as TW-102, low priority.
Jordan sent Harbor's renewal order form. Dana said the renewal should be routine.
